name: 1st Lobster
kurzbeschreibung: The 1st Lobster in Tirol Discover the 1st Lobster in Tirol – a culinary gem nestled in the heart of the Innsbruck region.
beschreibung: The 1st Lobster in Kitzbühel is a popular restaurant that delights its guests with a varied menu and regional charm. The setting blends traditional Tyrolean elements with modern comfort, creating a welcoming atmosphere for every occasion. The menu offers a thoughtful selection of dishes—from classic Tyrolean specialties like Tiroler Gröstl and Kaiserschmarrn to international classics. The team places special emphasis on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients from the area. Whether it’s a cozy dinner for two, a family celebration, or a business meeting, the 1st Lobster warmly welcomes you and ensures a perfectly enjoyable stay with attentive service.
